It may be more accurate to call it a lump of metal than a weapon, but if wielded by a Lynel, it can pound you into a fine dust.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 36 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Lynel Crusher}} Lynel Crushers are two-handed [[Weapon]]s favored by [[Lynel]]s. In [[Master Mode]], Lynel Crushers are wielded by [[Blue-Maned Lynel]]s. Though they are more of a lump of metal, they can be lethal in the hands of a Lynel. They belong to the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons created by Lynels.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} They are most commonly used by Lynels in the [[Gerudo Highlands]] and the [[Tabantha Frontier]]. Being made of metal, Lynel Crushers will attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. However, they are unable to be burned by [[Fire]] or in a [[Scorching Climate]], and they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]]. Additionally, Lynel Crushers will sink if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_016" |Life = 20 |Power = 36 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 17 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 22 |BuyingPrice = 54 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * Lynel Crushers are one of several [[Permanently Missable Items]] in {{BotW|-}}.
